Hi I'm Tori 👋🏼 I'm an endurance athlete with a background in kinesiology. I love digging into the numbers to see what they mean and using them to answer questions I'm curious about. I look at data from the sports I compete in and am passionate about, like running and triathlon, and from the ones I love to watch, like Formula 1. One question I've looked into is whether pole position really wins races in Formula 1.

Right now I'm working on my M.S. in Data Analytics, with a focus on Sports Performance and Sport Business. This page is where I share my projects as I go, mostly in R and SQL.

**Education**

- M.S. Data Analytics, Sport Performance & Sport Business emphasis, University of Mississippi (in progress)
- B.S. Kinesiology, Oregon State University

**Tools:** R (tidyverse, ggplot2, machine learning), MySQL, Quarto

**Experience**

- Facility Operations Team Member, Life Time
- Flexologist, StretchLab
- PT Aide & Office Assistant, Healing Motion Physical Therapy

**Off the clock:** Marathons, Ultras, HYROX, and training for my first Ironman 70.3 (July 2027).
